title.narrative: Supporting MS to equip citizens with relevant skills to meet individual, labour market and societal demands through ALE, TVET, STEM and Higher Education programs

description.narrative: This workplan is dedicated to fostering the development of skills among youth and adults in Chile and Ecuador, with a goal to empower them to realize their full potential in today’s world, both on a personal and professional level. The approach includes targeted strategies in Adult Learning and Education (ALE), Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET), Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), and Higher Education. For ALE, in line with the recommendations from the regional follow-up conference for CONFINTEA in Latin America, our focus will be on enhancing digital competencies among youth and adults. This involves improving information systems and bolstering the training of adult educators. In the TVET domain, the emphasis lies in supporting the execution of the national TVET strategies in both countries. This primarily includes the digital transformation of TVET systems and the creation of eco-friendlier and more sustainable TVET programs. Regarding STEM, efforts will be directed towards understanding the current state of STEM education in the region. This will be achieved through detailed case studies in select countries, aiming to identify key characteristics of the STEM educational landscape. Lastly, in the Higher Education sector, the proposed initiatives support the ratification of the Regional Convention on the Recognition of Studies, Diplomas, and Degrees in Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean, in both Chile and Ecuador. This step is crucial in further strengthening the educational framework and enhancing opportunities for students and professionals in these countries.
